thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: HIGH - db/redis connection saturation detected — paging team 'eng-oncall' (pager id PD-98321)
ryan (oncall): acked — I'm on it. pulling metrics now.
ryan (oncall): quick look: pgbouncer_active ~ 980/1000, pg connections queued, app 503s spiking across multiple routes. Redis maxclients at 10k, used ~9800, evictions increasing.
anna (sre): noted. any recent deploys?
ryan (oncall): not from deploy-bot in the last hour. traffic looks steady but slow tail latencies increased.
pagerduty-bot: Escalation: not acknowledged by owner within 3m, paging eng-lead.
ryan (oncall): I already acked, ignore PD escalation.
jorge (db): jumping in — can you paste pgbouncer stats and pg_stat_activity output?
ryan (oncall): paste: ```pgbouncer> SHOW POOLS; database=main user=svc_app
main svc_app 650 200 150 0 0.00 0.01
main readonly 300 50 20 0 0.00 0.00```
ryan (oncall): pg_stat_activity (top rows): ```pid|state|age|query
1234|idle|2h|<IDLE>
2345|active|00:10|SELECT ...
3456|idle|3h|<IDLE>```
ryan (oncall): a lot of long-idle sessions from a job user 'backfill_worker' and a few zombie connections from 10.12.8.0/24.
jorge (db): that explains it — idle sessions are holding slots in pgbouncer because client pooling isn't enabled for that client. can you run `SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state='idle' AND backend_start < now() - interval '1 hour';`
ryan (oncall): running... result: 412 idle >1h, 89 from backfill_worker.
tara (platform): @ryan can you temporarily increase pgbouncer max_client_conn and also add additional pgbouncer instances in the pool? we should be careful with shared DB max connections.
ryan (oncall): will increase pgbouncer max_client_conn from 1000 -> 1500 on the pool host and spin up one more pgbouncer. doing now.
anna (sre): we should also rate-limit the offending job. @cs-liaison can you surface which customers are seeing errors? need impact window & urls.
cs-liaison: working with observability — customer-facing 503 errors primarily on API keys prefix 'acct-prod-*'. pulling impacted list, will post in 5m.
incident-bot: Automated recommendation: scale pgbouncer pool, check long-running transactions, consider killing idle sessions after validation.
ryan (oncall): executing commands: ```ssh pgbouncer@pgpool-3 'systemctl scale pgbouncer@2' && psql -c \"ALTER SYSTEM SET max_connections = 500; SELECT pg_reload_conf();\"```
ryan (oncall): pgbouncer increased, new instance spun up, connection queue dropped by ~60% in ~90s.
jorge (db): please don't change DB max_connections without DB owner — we need to coordinate. rolling back the ALTER SYSTEM, instead suggest we adjust pool size and enforce client-side pooling.
ryan (oncall): rolled back DB change. we only scaled pgbouncer processes. queue cleared mostly.
anna (sre): good. but Redis still close to maxclients and evictions are loud — any offending clients?
ryan (oncall): `redis-cli -h cache-1 INFO clients` shows a burst of connections from host 10.24.33.12 (batch-export).
jorge (db): that batch-export job looks like it opens many ephemeral Redis conns and doesn't close them properly. can we throttle that job?
tara (platform): spun a temporary concurrency limit via Kubernetes HPA patch on the job controller: replicas -> 2 (was 8). that reduced new Redis connections.
ryan (oncall): immediate effect: redis clients down from 9800 -> 4300, evictions falling.
cs-liaison: impacted customers list: acct-prod-12, acct-prod-47, acct-prod-81 reported degraded API responses between 16:04-16:22 UTC. tickets opened.
anna (sre): status update for PD: issue contained, partial mitigation applied — pgbouncer scaled, job concurrency limited, redis connections reduced. continuing root cause.
jorge (db): I'm going to kill long-idle backfill_worker sessions but leaving a grace window for the job to finish. command: ```SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE usename='backfill_worker' AND state='idle' AND backend_start < now() - interval '2 hours';```
ryan (oncall): ok terminated 86 sessions, pgbouncer free slots increased.
anna (sre): any regressions in application? @ryan any error spikes after terminations?
ryan (oncall): minor spikes for a minute while clients reconnected, then normal. no new 5xx after redis evictions dropped.
jorge (db): will follow up with backfill job owner to add proper connection pooling and graceful shutdown.
tara (platform): created a short-lived deployment patch that forces job to use pooled library and reduced max concurrency. pushing a canary to 10% now.
anna (sre): good. assign owners and next steps in this thread for postmortem.
ryan (oncall): summary: root cause = orphaned/backfill jobs + misconfigured job concurrency causing DB and Redis connection saturation. mitigation = scale pgbouncer, reduce job concurrency, terminate idle sessions. customer impact = transient 503s for subset of customers for ~20m.
cs-liaison: pushed incident notice to affected customers and CS is triaging replies.
pagerduty-bot: Incident marked acknowledged by ryan (oncall).
anna (sre): next actions (owners): jorge -> write DB-side guard (kill idle after X), tara -> make job concurrency patch permanent, ryan -> run follow-up health checks and draft timeline, cs-liaison -> compile impacted customers + ticket list.
ryan (oncall): I'll start the timeline now and run post-incident queries.
jorge (db): I'll schedule a change to postgresql.conf and coordinate maintenance window if we need to increase DB max connections long-term.
anna (sre): good. closing pager now but keeping this thread open until postmortem. :white_check_mark:
ryan (oncall): closing pager on PD, marking incident mitigated. thanks all. :thumbsup:
cs-liaison: posting final customer update and linking ticket numbers.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: RESOLVE - PD-98321 (resolved by ryan (oncall))
anna (sre): filing a short postmortem doc in #postmortems and assigning action items.
ryan (oncall): adding logs & graphs to the doc shortly.
